$comment: REL-03: components redistributed in packages that are not Cargo or npm packages. Each text file in this folder is a verbatim copy from the named origin. scripts/notices/generate-notices.mjs reads this file.

components.name: Rust standard library
components.source: rustc 1.99.1 (58cf8f9c3 2026-10-13), statically linked into every Downova binary
unresolved: the standard library's per-file and out-of-tree notices (share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html in the toolchain, about 1.5 MB, including Unicode-3.0 data) are not yet bundled

components.name: NSIS (installer stub and plug-ins)
components.source: Nullsoft Scriptable Install System as downloaded by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3 (%LOCALAPPDATA%\tauri\NSIS); its stub and plug-ins are part of the NSIS setup executable
unresolved: which compression module (zlib, bzip2 or LZMA) the Tauri NSIS script selects is not yet confirmed, so all three licenses are listed

components.name: nsis_tauri_utils (NSIS plug-in)
components.source: Plugins\x86-unicode\additional\nsis_tauri_utils.dll, downloaded by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3; the DLL carries no version or copyright resource
unresolved: version and license are not recorded in the binary; confirm them from the release the Tauri CLI pins

components.name: WiX Toolset UI and extension resources
components.source: WiX Toolset 3.14 as downloaded by the Tauri CLI 2.12.3 (%LOCALAPPDATA%\tauri\WixTools314); the MSI embeds its dialog resources
unresolved: which WiX extension binaries or resources end up inside the MSI is not yet confirmed from the MSI tables

external.name: aria2
external.reason: not bundled in any package (ADR 0005, REL-05); used only with --backend aria2 and a user-supplied or fetched binary. Bundling it would require its GPL-2.0-or-later notices and corresponding source.

external.name: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
external.reason: not embedded; Windows provides it, and the installer downloads Microsoft's bootstrapper only when it is missing

external.name: System WebView (WKWebView on macOS, WebKitGTK on Linux) and system libraries
external.reason: provided by the operating system or the package manager; not redistributed
